core_obligations: Algebraicity: the quotient stack of the groupoid is an algebraic stack (proof lines 7708-7711)

Smoothness is checked after base change: the covering of the quotient is flat and locally of finite presentation, and the base change of the structure morphism along it is smooth because it factors through the smooth morphism from the group action's source (proof lines 7712-7718)
Descent: smoothness descends along the flat finitely presented covering, so the quotient is smooth over the base (proof lines 7719-7724)
proof_roadmap: 由平坦群胚定理，[X/G] 是代数栈。
取 X → [X/G] 的覆盖（满平坦局部有限表现）；其上的基变换 U ×_{[X/G]} X → U 经 X → Y 分解而光滑。
由「光滑性沿满平坦局部有限表现覆盖下降」得 [X/G] → Y 光滑。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that if a smooth algebraic space carries an action of a group algebraic space flat and locally of finite presentation over the base, then the quotient stack is smooth over the base (author lemma at source lines 7697-7703, label lemma-smooth-quotient-stack). The proof (source lines 7708-7725) applies the flat groupoid theorem, checks smoothness of the structure morphism after the flat finitely presented covering by the source of the action and descends (proof lines 7708-7724). The base change computation and the descent step are the substance. H3.
